capabilities: Edit structured data fields in a searchable right-sidebar editor
Compute values with arithmetic formulas (sum, min, max, round and similar)
Generate a Markdown note from a reusable template and a JSON source
Auto-sync or manually sync the generated note after source or template changes
Configure locale and currency formatting per connection
extras: Status is release candidate and not yet community-approved; the README warns to back up the vault before installing an unpublished development build. Complete examples are in examples/connected-notes/.
motivation: The author wanted to change a value once and keep every total and repeated reference up to date, starting with a financial planning note with recurring amounts, calculations and tables.
problem: Obsidian offers no way to keep structured values beside a document and have totals and repeated references in a generated note update automatically.
summary: Sidebar data editor that stores values in a JSON file and regenerates a Markdown note from a reusable template when values or the template change.
